title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and for many years of reliable partnership, which we value as well.

Our should-cost estimate for part:310010 is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010), below your price.
The forecast for part:310010 increased by 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.
PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.

We attach three alternative packages for 8150 pieces per year over 12 months. Because you asked about faster payment, one package pays within 14 days to support your cash flow. Which package suits you best, and is there a cheaper variant you could offer?

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal for 2027
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the volume change data you cited, which holds and we took into account, as well as the should cost data you cited, which also holds and we took into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

We are pleased to accept your proposed 14-day payment terms, though our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Thus, our current Angebot stands at a price of €132.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings – volume commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for accepting 14-day payment, which supports your cash flow as you requested.

On volume: our attached packages commit to 8150 pieces per year over a 12-month contract, the full need for part:310010.

Your latest scorecard records on-time delivery of 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3).

We have moved towards you in both attached packages. The first keeps your terms of 14-day payment from 1 November 2026. The second pairs your standard 30-day payment with a 1 January 2027 start, which eases your transition. Which package suits you better? Is there another variant that would help your margin or workload?

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings – volume commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We are pleased to build on your first package, maintaining the 14-day payment terms and the 1 November 2026 start date. While our margin and internal calculations remain confidential, the verified data allows us to offer a revised price of €130.30 per unit. Our margin and our limits stay internal.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €130.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for keeping the 14-day payment and the 1 November 2026 start.

On volume: both attached packages commit to 8150 pieces per year over a 12-month contract. That is our full need for part:310010.

Your previous scorecard records 626 ppm (sc:70110@2026Q2).

We remember that you kept supplying at the old price in 2022, and we want a fair, lasting arrangement in return. The first package keeps your terms exactly: fast payment for your cash flow, from 1 November 2026. The second pairs your standard 30-day payment with a 1 January 2027 start. Which suits your planning better?

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - revised packages
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to stay in direct contact with your house. As a family-run foundry deeply rooted in our region, we cherish the long relationship between our companies and the joint history we share. 

We have carefully reviewed your offer. The quality record you cited is a duplicate of the kind of data we have already factored into our previous concession. As there is no new data to justify further movement, we hold our Angebot. Our offer remains firm at a price of €130.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To help us understand your perspective, which figures is that based on? Please send us the data so we can review your foundation. 

We remain committed to our partnership and look forward to hearing from you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.subject: Part 310010 – quality record and packages for signature
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your reply and for the 8D report, including your containment through 100 % outgoing inspection.

You asked for the data behind our view. Our quality notifications qn:20004728, qn:20004837, qn:20004853, qn:20004877, qn:20004934, qn:20004978, qn:20004995 record defective deliveries of part:310010.

On volume: all attached packages commit to 8150 pieces per year over a 12-month contract. The first package keeps your 14-day payment and 1 November 2026 start, which supports your cash flow.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Part 310010 – quality record and packages for signature
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the quality notifications you cited; as this is the same kind of data we already factored into our previous concession, it does not change our calculation. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our margin and our limits stay internal. 

Please note that our Angebot stands at a price of €130.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days. We are ready to sign today at this price.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your willingness to conclude this agreement today. For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company, and we deeply value the strong relationship our businesses have built over the years. 

As no new data has been provided to change our calculation, we cannot make any further concessions. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot) at a price of €130.30 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Please note that this Angebot remains valid for 7 days. Please decide on this basis.

This is our final offer at €130.30 per unit, and we look forward to your signature to continue our long-standing partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
